question: The value of 3 × 4 ÷ 3 of 24 - 3 ÷ 2 × (3 - 4) × 2 + 6 ÷ 4 of 3 is :
solution:
**Concept used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/DqGeimUPJQzAKKGjHnzwX5X09naJBwjX1Qk7j89CBk-qxgb2XPtbpzgIQpbqxtVcqG2Q86Bkuk_YNIVQVdp_1rP_u9JKWgKgX78qGmeCWzX_Z44YIpQi4TynYEt0WtipVVZTuiYWB8M9RqrVoE4MoQ] 

**Calculation:**

3 × 4 ÷ 3 of 24 - 3 ÷ 2 × (3 - 4) × 2 + 6 ÷ 4 of 3

⇒ 3 × 4 ÷ 3 of 24 - 3 ÷ 2 × (-1) × 2 + 6 ÷ 4 of 3

⇒ 3 × 4 ÷ 72 - 3 ÷ 2 × (-1) × 2 + 6 ÷ 12

⇒ 3 × 4 × 1/72 - 3/2 × (-2) + 1/2

⇒ 1/6 + 3 + 1/2 = (1 + 18 + 3)/6

⇒ 22/6 = 11/3 

⇒ 3 (2)/(3)

**∴ The value of 3 × 4 ÷ 3 of 24 - 3 ÷ 2 × (3 - 4) × 2 + 6 ÷ 4 of 3 is 3(2)/(3)**
